question: What kind of data did release 25.1 add to the Single Cell resource, and across how many cell types and how many tissues?

result.question: What kind of data did release 25.1 add to the Single Cell resource, and across how many cell types and how many tissues?
result.text: Protein Atlas release 25.1 added Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) data, consisting of cell-type resolved mass spectrometry-based protein profiles, to the Single Cell resource [1]. These data cover 27 different cell types (grouped into 24 cell types for classifications) across 14 different tissues [1].

citations.quote: The latest addition to the Single Cell resource is Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) data. Cell-type resolved MS-based protein profiles across 27 different cell types, representing 14 different tissues, are integrated into the Single Cell resource.

result.summary_md:
Protein Atlas release 25.1 added Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) data, consisting of cell-type resolved mass spectrometry-based protein profiles, to the Single Cell resource [1]. These data cover 27 different cell types (grouped into 24 cell types for classifications) across 14 different tissues [1].
